evals.prompt: 帮我创建一个 TransFlow 任务，名字叫 '日志处理'，描述是 '过滤错误日志并输出到控制台'。流程是：TXT-INPUT 输入一些测试日志，经过 IF-ELSE 过滤包含 'ERROR' 的行，最后输出到 CONSOLE。请创建任务、配置流程，并验证节点配置正确。
evals.expected_output: 成功创建任务，配置包含3个节点（TXT-INPUT -> IF-ELSE -> CONSOLE）的flow，IF-ELSE条件为包含'ERROR'的表达式

assertions.name: task_created
assertions.description: POST /api/tasks returned 200 with valid task object

assertions.name: three_nodes
assertions.description: Flow contains exactly 3 nodes: TXT-INPUT, IF-ELSE, CONSOLE

assertions.name: error_filter_condition
assertions.description: IF-ELSE node config contains a condition referencing ERROR

assertions.name: edges_correct
assertions.description: Flow has edges connecting TXT-INPUT -> IF-ELSE -> CONSOLE

evals.prompt: 帮我查看所有 TransFlow 任务，并获取第一个任务的节点状态和输出。
evals.expected_output: 列出所有任务，然后获取第一个任务的节点状态map和各个OUTPUT节点的输出数据

assertions.name: output_fetched
assertions.description: GET /api/flow-data/output/{nodeId} was called for at least one output node

evals.prompt: 我有一个 TransFlow 任务叫 'a'（ID: bf3526f1），帮我向它的 TXT-INPUT 节点发送一条测试数据 '{"test": "hello"}'，然后检查 TXT-OUT 节点的输出结果。
evals.expected_output: 成功向TXT-INPUT节点注入数据，并从TXT-OUT节点获取到处理后的输出

assertions.name: data_emitted
assertions.description: POST /api/flow-data/emit returned 200 with data sent to the TXT-INPUT node

assertions.name: output_checked
assertions.description: GET /api/flow-data/output/{nodeId} returned results from the TXT-OUT node

assertions.name: correct_task_id
assertions.description: The task ID bf3526f1 was used for the emit call
